brief.genre: orchestral-hybrid broadcast anthem (sports TV theme meets Federation ceremony)
brief.mood: proud, warm, a little tongue-in-cheek grand
brief.use: main menu loop under the home / Kick Off / options screens
brief.game: Fuzeball: 3D table football run by a far-too-serious intergalactic Federation; cramped grubby venues, gold-plated ceremony
brief.references: TV football broadcast themes, Olympic-style fanfares, kept small enough to leave room for UI clicks
brief.notes: E Mixolydian to match the UI sound kit (E suspended pentatonic: E F# A B D); avoid D#. Intro 4 bars once, loop A(8) B(8) C breakdown(8). Motif: E-F#-A-B rising, answered by D-C#-A (the Mixolydian bVII). Intro and loop end both bVI-bVII-I so the seam matches the intro's arrival. Not neon sci-fi: no supersaws, no cyber arps. Target -18 LUFS.
